item.description:
Prompt, rebuilt around how it's actually used. Messages to an assistant keep your first person, your hedges and your questions; pauses are mended; a report never comes back as an order. When a rewrite would change your meaning, you get Clean's pass instead of the bare transcript.

Flow's surf rolls. A slow, irregular swell under the wash — never a breathing rhythm; the beat holds steady.

Sounds have versions. Breathe and Flow each show a sound version and a code in Settings, so you can tell exactly which sound a build carries.

Also: "one point nought" comes out as 1.0, and "binaural" spells itself.
